## TASK-001 - Freeze the selected implementation and preservation boundary

After separate execution authorization, record exact source, Template and depot-root package manifests, current owner compatibility, protected preimages and the shared verification map. Use the applicable Task workflow for execution; plan task IDs are not project Task ledger IDs.

### Risks

- A dirty shared checkout and active Template watcher can obscure ownership; use exact manifests and the existing updater coordination procedure.
- Existing historical Task transaction warnings belong to their owner and must not be repaired by app planning or browsing.

### Acceptance criteria

- The execution cites this exact plan revision and TRD revision 2, identifies its real writer, and names each selected destination and overwrite boundary.
- The manifest distinguishes mandatory app package files from optional reader adapters and protects all existing governed records, custom text/configuration, unrelated changes and nonselected projects.
- One verification map reuses existing evidence and names only changed behavior with an uncovered risk; it retains the exclusions in REQ-030.

### Planned verification

- Inspect current source/installed inventories, owner interfaces, repository state, package/guard bindings and Template watcher state; record hashes and reuse limits without running the old full-release suite.

## TASK-002 - Define project identity and reviewed Home content

Specify a small versioned project-app.json contract for identity binding, project-owned Home text, selected document references, source digests and review metadata. Primary identity comes from project.json, or the depot self entry for the exact depot root; optional owner IDs must agree or only that adapter becomes unavailable.

| Dependencies | TASK-001 |
| Parallel group | None |

### Risks

- Keep provenance as bounded content metadata, with no new approval service, second identity registry or runtime generation.
- Project-owned metadata and primary identity must not become paths the browser may choose.

### Acceptance criteria

- Home has bounded purpose, scope, audience, Start here and permitted supporting links; empty source information remains a labeled gap.
- Each reviewed content section binds its supporting source bytes and reviewed output; changed sources mark review need, revoked sources withhold derived text, and page loads never rewrite it.
- The depot fallback reads only its self identity; a generic child does not need a live depot. Missing/conflicting primary identity gives setup guidance; neutral Template identity cannot run as the depot.

### Planned verification

- Review the proposed schema and identity rules against current initializer selected_identity, registry, communication guidance and REQ-002/008/021; reserve behavioral proof for the shared verification tasks.
